transfer_from_in_progress.meaning: an external transferFrom call is currently executing within the Distributor flow

reentered_during_transfer.meaning: an external function performing transfers/state changes is re-entered while the external transferFrom call is in progress

reentrancy_window_open.meaning: a reentrancy window exists that can be used for griefing

assumptions: The external transferFrom call is the checked transition during which re-entry must not occur.
The impact is potential: the reentrancy window may be used for griefing, not an inevitable loss.

unresolved.description: Report does not state which external function is re-entered or the concrete re-entry path; the re-entry occurrence is represented only as a grounded Boolean.

limitations: No frozen precondition sources were supplied, so P is empty.
The griefing consequence is potential and not formalized as a certain outcome.
Re-entry occurrence is a qualitative Boolean pending code-level binding.
